rules.rule_1: Any required scenario marked UNKNOWN or NOT_RUN blocks PUBLIC_RELEASE_READY.
rules.rule_2: Test counts or green historical outputs cannot substitute for named scenario PASS.
rules.rule_3: Evidence classes must remain distinct; a browser fixture or direct sidecar cannot substitute for installed native shell evidence.

evidence_classes.description: Pure in-memory unit tests using hand-derived or synthetic domain fixtures.
Production services (MonitoringService, OpportunityService, CostAdvisorService, DiagnosticsService) exercised with deterministic fixtures.
Actual network calls to public REST and WebSocket endpoints of Coinbase and Kraken.
Packaged or direct sidecar engine stdin/stdout JSON Lines boundary exercised with real serialized requests.
Frontend UI components and hooks exercised in browser environment against real serialized outputs.
Installed macOS Tauri 2 application shell launching and controlling the packaged Python sidecar.
Authorized GitHub Actions workflow execution on supported clean runners.
Artifact validation: DMG mounting, codesign strict inspection, notarization stapling, shasum verification.

verifier_negatives_definition.B01: All venue samples fail / zero usable data -> live gate fails (non-zero exit).
verifier_negatives_definition.B02: Scenario interrupted before target completions -> incomplete status, non-zero exit.
verifier_negatives_definition.B03: Native app missing -> native gate fails, sidecar ping fallback rejected.
verifier_negatives_definition.B04: Manifest empty, README-only, or missing required release files -> release gate fails.
verifier_negatives_definition.B05: Hash mismatch, wrong architecture, or unbound cached binary -> build/provenance gate fails.
verifier_negatives_definition.B06: Ad hoc signing, missing TeamIdentifier, unnotarized -> distribution gate fails.
verifier_negatives_definition.B07: Quota, queue, RSS limit exceeded or measurement absent -> resource scenario fails.
verifier_negatives_definition.B08: Required test skipped, disabled, or stale report -> final acceptance fails.
verifier_negatives_definition.B09: Empty, tampered, or partial replay/incident bundle -> rejection, no exact/reproduced claim.
verifier_negatives_definition.B10: Intentionally broken contract in isolated build -> aggregate gate fails.
